messages:
Omar Ruiz: Quick kickoff: VoltEdge pilot to validate perf/W improvements with kernel tuning. Targets: steady 2.8k toks/s at 12k context and track watt-per-token. Cal from VoltEdge is on.
Priya Nair: Agree. Measurement surface: p95 latency, sustained throughput over 15m windows, per-GPU W, chassis PDU, and thermal events. Also capture GPU util and freq.
Cal - VoltEdge: We'll provide per-board sensors and our kernel team. Baseline: ~2.2k toks/s @ 295W (PDU). Happy to run synchronized tests Wed morning.
Omar Ruiz: Marketing nod: Rina will draft guarded copy. No absolute SLA claims. Keep messaging to "validated with partner" unless legal signs off.
Rina (Product): Noted. We want two visuals: perf/W curve and stability timeline. Also a short-cased blurb for marketplace listing if green.
Priya Nair: Tech plan: 1) baseline capture (stock kernel), 2) patch set 1 (fused-attn micro-optim), 3) patch set 2 (KV reorder + scheduling), 4) 1-hour soak. Collect raw CSVs with 1s granularity.
Cal - VoltEdge: We'll mirror binary+bench harness. Do you prefer raw logs or aggregated metrics?
Priya Nair: Raw CSVs preferred + compressed parquet. Include UTC timestamps. We'll run our analysis notebook.
bench-bot: bench-scheduler: Reserved bench window: 2025-06-18 09:00 PT. Notifying #eng-infra.
Omar Ruiz: Action list: Priya to push patch PR and run initial microbench; Cal to upload PDU traces and per-board telemetry; Rina to draft joint blurb; Omar to circulate partner checklist and legal contact. Post short summaries here.
Cal - VoltEdge: Will upload baseline CSV before the run and confirm kernel engs. We'll also run a 30m warmup to stabilize temps.
Priya Nair: Quick run snippet I'll use: 
```bash
export RW_SEQ=12288
./run_bench --model redwood-sprint --bs 1 --quant q4_0 --kern-patch=opt_fuse --out=csv
```
Omar Ruiz: If we observe >=14% perf/W uplift with no quality regressions, we escalate to case study draft. Keep the thread internal until partner sign-off. :eyes:
